run_multiproc_bitext_processor_module: run the MultiprocBitextProcessorModule to process parallel bitext shards using joblib workers
find_line_offsets: find line offsets in a file to split it into equal chunks for parallel processing
create_multiproc_bitext_processor_callba: create a MultiprocBitextProcessorCallback subclass to process bitext chunks with line offset tracking
process_file_chunk: process a chunk of bitext lines between start and end offsets using a configured processor
merge_parallel_results: merge results from parallel bitext processing chunks into a single final result
